title: $L$-classes of symmetric products: a homological formula
summary: If $M$ is a closed oriented manifold of even dimension, then its $n$th symmetric product $M(n)=M^n/S_n$ is a rational homology manifold for any $n \geq 0$ and hence has a canonically defined $L$-class in $H^*(M(n);\mathbb{Q})$. A complicated formula for these classes was given many years ago in the second author's thesis. We obtain a simpler result by studying the dual classes in homology, showing that their generating function (after embedding each $H_*(M(n); \mathbb{Q})$ into the Hopf algebra $H_*(M(\infty); \mathbb{Q})$) is the product of an elementary factor depending only on the Euler…
